question: What pattern did a 2010 study find growing, decade by decade, in the lengths of Hollywood shots?
answer: A 1/f rhythm, the statistical pattern also found in how human attention drifts. James Cutting's team measured the shots of 150 films from 1935 to 2005: runs of long and short shots clustered at every scale, more strongly in later films. Nobody planned it; editors converged on it by feel, one cut at a time.
move: A pattern nobody designed can still emerge from many small choices made by feel.
reference: Cutting, DeLong & Nothelfer, Attention and the Evolution of Hollywood Film, Psychological Science 21(3), 2010
